**Client:** Pavement Recycling Systems (California public works)  
**Goal:** Predict bid win probability using historical estimate data from B2W & D365.

## Key Contributions
- Built a win probability model using logistic regression + gradient boosting
- Conducted budget vs. actual cost variance analysis
- Delivered actionable insights to improve bid strategy
